Location: 2801 Buford Hwy NE #250, Atlanta, GA 30329 (Brookhaven area)
Specialty: Full-service prosthodontics, restorative dentistry, and custom natural-looking replacement teeth.

Rating: 4.9/5 to 5/5 across locations Atlanta Dental Spa +2

Locations: Midtown Atlanta and Acworth
Specialty: All-on-4® implants, same-day emergency appointments, and on-site dental labs.
Rating: 4.9/5 georgiadic.com +2
Lead Doctor: Periodontist and implant specialist Dr. Yoon / Dr. Toon
Locations: Duluth and Stockbridge
Specialty: Dual board-certified implant specialists with digital-first operations and promotional pricing (e.g., $1,999 single implant specials).
Rating: 4.9/5 to 5/5 with over 4,000 reviews
Cost Range: In the Atlanta area, a standard single-tooth dental implant (including the post, abutment, and ceramic crown) typically ranges from $5,000 to $6,000 total. Full-arch solutions (such as All-on-4) generally range from $19,500 to $40,000+ depending on the materials used (e.g., zirconia vs. titanium-acrylic). ATL Dental Implants +2
Prosthodontist vs. Periodontist vs. General Dentist: For complex cases, bone grafting, or aesthetic front-tooth replacements, look for a prosthodontist (specializing in tooth restoration and replacement) or a periodontist (specializing in gum tissue and jawbone/implant placement) rather than a general practitioner.
If you share whether you need a single tooth replaced, full-mouth restoration (All-on-4), or your insurance/budget preferences, I can narrow down the best fit in your specific part of Atlanta.
